scope: WS7 3D systems, pipeline side (DankoLiv with Claude Code): the curated SystemModel catalog of the five challenge targets and the synthetic demo system (catalog.py), the NASA Exoplanet Archive, SIMBAD and Gaia DR3 fetchers that the network tests re-run (sources.py), hierarchy validation and writers (build.py), errante systems in cli.py, their tests in test_systems.py and the systems JSON in data/demo/systems and data/products/systems; plus, in #90 (V13, with V4 and V12), the removal of hand-picked temperature, radius and mass values, the frozen WS3 object-context snapshots in systems/inputs/objects/, the targets.toml registry (with the 'seen by SPHEREx' facts copied verbatim from docs/SCIENCE.md, block A5), measured.py (including a generic system_from_snapshot builder, tested offline but not used by any published system), record.py and the errante systems --explain and --record flags. The frontend side of the same work is recorded in frontend/src/three/ai-usage.json
real_target_validation_basis: A 3D model of a target is not an R05 validation (AGENTS.md rule 3). The formal per-target validation records are the coordinator's (docs/validation/) and their human review was signed on 2026-11-15 (#126, docs/VALIDATION.md); the 'seen by SPHEREx' facts in the systems are copied from those records, not re-measured by WS7
human_review: DankoLiv directs the WS7 work done with Claude Code, chooses its design decisions and reviews the changes; that review is in progress and is not claimed complete, and a line-by-line human review of the code, tests or data is not claimed

integration_validation.source: catalog and literature values (NASA Exoplanet Archive, SIMBAD, Gaia DR3, AAVSO VSX and the cited papers), with 'seen by SPHEREx' facts copied from docs/validation/; no SPHEREx pixel is drawn in 3D
integration_validation.arbitrary_coordinate_job: not part of WS7: there is no 3D for an arbitrary click yet (V14, future work)
integration_validation.golden_fields: errante systems --out data/products --real-only publishes the five challenge systems in data/products/systems, each with the field_id of its real SPHEREx field (#64); data/demo/systems holds the same five plus the synthetic demo-ecliptic-orbits system
checks_reported_in_pull_requests: #9: every value of the five challenge-target systems was checked against the NASA Exoplanet Archive, SIMBAD (CfA mirror), Gaia DR3, VizieR and the cited papers, each by one researcher and one independent cross-checker; the fetchers are re-run by tests marked network

#47: pytest checks that Basant et al. 2025's t0 of Barnard b, propagated 33 cycles, reaches the conjunction of González Hernández et al. 2024, and that the VSX values of R Dra are equal in catalog.py and in the frontend table
#64: tests check that the committed real systems equal the catalog and point at real fields of data/products
integration_validation.checks_basis: Run with AI assistance and reported in the pull request bodies (squash commit messages); not independently verified by a human

input_snapshots.origin: Recorded offline with Claude Code by replaying WS3's committed fixtures (pipeline/tests/fixtures/ws3/context/, live service answers WS3 recorded on 2026-11-15 between 03:44 and 04:22 UTC) through WS3's object_context(..., offline=True); each file keeps the contract Facts and numeric parameters WS3 derived, with WS3's source text
input_snapshots.labels: Catalog values from the snapshots are labelled 'catalog, not measured by SPHEREx'; parameters no source gives stay unknown and the system notes say why

cache_revision: No WS7 change to the processing cache: the systems build reads only committed files (catalog.py and, on ws7/measured-3d, targets.toml and inputs/objects/*.json) and makes no network call; WS4's processing fingerprint (backend/errante_api/processing.py) hashes the data, imaging and detect modules, not systems
model_basis: Co-Authored-By trailers of the WS7 commits name Claude Opus 5.5 (the cloud-session squash commits also carry a generic 'Claude' trailer); subagents ran inside Claude Code and their individual models were not recorded
other_ai_tools: OpenAI Codex: rpccp integrated the imported WS7 cloud-session branch with the challenge and submission guides in #1 (AI_USAGE.md, 'Imported 3D contribution'); that use is recorded by its author
other_ai_tools_basis: The commit trailers of the WS7 pull requests listed here name only Claude, except where the integration in #1 is described as done with Codex in AI_USAGE.md; no other AI model, provider or coding tool, and no PRC-origin one, is known to have been used for this work
ai_review: The #8 and #9 commit messages report an independent review of the 3D skeleton (16 confirmed issues) and #47 reports stage-1 and stage-3 review checks; on ws7/measured-3d an AI critic pass checked the V13 plan before implementation. These ran as AI agents in Claude Code: they are AI reviews, not human reviews. WS3's scientific review of the merged 3D (#65, docs/SCIENCE.md) is WS3's record, not this one
idea_origin: Not covered by this record: the product vision, including the rule that the 3D is built only from measurements, was stated by the team (docs/VISION.md; AI_USAGE.md, 'Origin of the product vision'). DankoLiv chose the WS7 design decisions recorded in docs/VISION_3D.md from options proposed in Claude Code sessions

rendered_products.paths: data/products/systems/<id>.json and data/demo/systems/<id>.json (SystemModel JSON written by errante systems); the 3D scenes are drawn from them in the browser by frontend/src/three/
rendered_products.origin: The systems JSON is written by running the AI-assisted WS7 code on catalog, literature and recorded WS3 values; it holds numbers and text with their sources, not imagery. 'fields' lists the real SPHEREx fields the published systems link to through field_id
rendered_products.labels: Every view shows '3D MODEL · NOT AN IMAGE' and the representation_note; each Fact carries its source and verified flag; the synthetic demo-ecliptic-orbits system (data/demo only) is labelled SYNTHETIC DATA
rendered_products.nasa_branding: No NASA logo, flag or mission identifier was generated, added or modified
